matched_horizon_note: Full-model results use the first7500 s of each long reference run, matching the original ablation horizon.

rules.episode_prefix: Keep completed episodes with exit <= analysis horizon before grouping.
rules.collective_events: Original metrics_w2.canonical: release-to-exit chains with 1-s separation; unique participants; event start >=300 s and event end <=T-2 s.
rules.individual_intervals: Consecutive completed episodes per fish; preceding exit >=300 s and next release <=T; pool intervals within each run.
rules.polarization: Norm of mean 3D heading over current schooling fish, averaged across retained samples.
rules.low_height_fraction: Fraction of retained samples with the whole-population median height <1 BL.
rules.rhythm_flag: Descriptive post-hoc flag: mean schooling polarization <0.2 AND low_height_fraction >=0.95. Not a statistical test for periodicity.
rules.baseline: Ten W1 runs truncated to7500 s; do not substitute their full13440-s metrics.
